ns2:course.label: Design Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Individually directed research in the studio with concentration in design. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Enrollment in the MFA program in graphic design or consent of departmental graduate committee.
